sources.title: Visit - The Shanghai Museum East (Official)
sources.content:
Hours & Admission: Wednesday to Monday, 10:00-18:00 (last entry at 17:00). Closed on Tuesdays (except national holidays).

Individual visitors need valid ID through B1 East Gate (near Dingxiang Road). Groups of 20+ require advance phone reservation (021-20729999 ext. 134) 7-14 days prior, entering via North Gate (1F).

Location: 1952 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

Transportation: Metro Line 2 (Shanghai Technology Museum, Exit 8); Line 4 (Xiangcheng Road, Exit 2); Line 6 (Pudian Road, Exit 1). Buses: Routes 638, 975, 987, Pudong 36, Pudong 106.

Key Facilities: Information Centre & Tickets (1F). Cloakroom, Baby care room, Medical kit. Multiple cafés on 1F-4F. Accessible toilets on all floors.

Services: Free WiFi guides via QR code. Audio guides: 20-40 yuan (Chinese/English). Smart guides: 30+ yuan rental. AR smart glasses: 60 yuan. Paid English guided tours starting 300 yuan. Wheelchair/stroller loans (valid ID or 300 yuan deposit required).

Rules: Visitors cannot touch exhibits, run, use flash photography, set up easels, or conduct unauthorized recordings.

sources.title: A guide to visiting Shanghai Museum East - Shanghai Government
sources.content:
Shanghai Museum East, the east branch of the museum in Pudong New Area has a total floor space of nearly 120,000 square meters, with 13 permanent galleries.

Bronze Gallery: Explores 3,600 years of Chinese ancient bronze art, spanning from Xia Dynasty to Qing Dynasty.

Sculpture Gallery: Features 289 sculptures including bone, jade, bronze, wood, and pottery figurines, with one-third displayed for the first time.

Jade Gallery: Showcases artifacts spanning from the Neolithic era to the Qing Dynasty.

Seal Gallery: Displays 568 artifacts examining Chinese seals within global context, with 35% newly added items.

Calligraphy & Painting Galleries: World's only permanent exhibitions that present the history of ancient Chinese calligraphy and painting separately, displaying national treasures recently upgraded.

Shanghai Painting and Calligraphy Gallery: Explores Jiangnan, Haipai, and Shanghai's red culture through artwork.

Ceramics Gallery: Records Chinese ceramic history.

CeraMIX Gallery: Chronicles economic, cultural, and political exchanges between China and other countries via ceramic trade history.

Numismatics Gallery: Contains over 6,000 coins documenting currency development.

Zhao Puchu Calligraphy Gallery: Explores the prominent calligrapher's life (1907-2000).

Archaeology Gallery: Displays over 2,000 relics illustrating Shanghai's urban evolution across 6,000 years.

Jiangnan Gallery: Presents regional artifacts in a minimalist setting with natural light.

Hours: 10 am–6 pm (Admission stops at 5 pm). Closed every Tuesday except holidays. Location: No 1952 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area. Metro: Lines 2, 4, or 6. Entry: Valid identification through B1 East Gate; groups of 20+ require advance phone reservations.

sources.title: Ultimate Guide to the Shanghai Museum East Wing
sources.content:
To plan your visit, search for 'Shanghai Museum' on WeChat to make a reservation for either the East Wing or the People's Square location.

Hours: 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM, closed on Tuesdays. Location: 1952 Pudong New Century Avenue. Metro Line 2 at Shanghai Science and Technology Museum station, exiting through Gates 7 or 8, then walking 500-700 meters.

During the summer, the museum can be quite cool, so it's advisable to dress warmly.

Admission: Free entry. ID Requirements: Bring identification; children under 12 and seniors over 65 bypass reservation requirements. Security: Lighters are confiscated but retrievable at exit.

Shuttle Services: Operation Days: Wednesday to Monday and on public holidays. Departure Times: 11:00 AM, 12:00 PM, 1:00 PM, 2:00 PM, and 3:00 PM. Ticket Price: 4 RMB.

Exhibition Floors:
Level 1: Bronze Gallery, Sculpture Gallery, special exhibitions
Level 2: Seal and Carving Gallery, Jade Gallery, Digital Gallery, themed post office
Level 3: Ceramics Gallery, Currency Gallery, Ancient Culture Exploration Gallery
Level 4: Archaeology Gallery, Cultural Relics Restoration Gallery, Creative Workshop

Complimentary guidebooks and maps available upon entry.

sources.title: Shanghai Museum: Top Exhibits, Tips & Culture Guide
sources.content:
The Shanghai Museum, located at 201 Renmin Avenue in Huangpu District, spans 12,000 square meters with four floors housing collections of bronzes, ceramics, calligraphy, paintings, jade, coins, and more. It contains over 1 million artifacts, including 144,000 rare treasures and has been open since 1996.

Shanghai Museum East: Located on Century Avenue in Pudong New Area, this 46,000 sq.m. facility features 20 exhibition halls. Hours: 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM (last entry 5:00 PM), closed Tuesdays except holidays. Collections: Comprehensive history of ancient Chinese art with renowned ceramics and currency collections. Amenities: Free luggage storage, baby strollers, wheelchairs, restaurant on B1, café on 1st floor, free water on all floors. Transportation: Metro Line 2: Science and Technology Museum Station. Free parking for up to 5 hours.

Top 10 Museum Treasures: Da Ke Ding bronze vessel, Xi Zun sacrificial vessel, Zhan Guo Shang Yang Fang Sheng offering, stone Bodhisattva statue, Shijiahe Culture jade figure, Jin Guiyi gold seal, Sun Wei landscape scroll, Huai Su calligraphy, Jingdezhen famille rose vase, Ru kiln celadon plate.

Visitor Tips: Suggested visit duration: 3-4 hours. Follow bottom-to-top visiting order for best experience. Visit early morning or weekdays for fewer crowds. Use audio guides for detailed information. Special exhibits require reservations.

sources.title: Explore the Shanghai Museum: Your Essential Visitor's Guide
sources.content:
The newly-built Shanghai Museum East opened in February 2024, featuring a contemporary white jade-inspired tower with 20 exhibition halls. The museum holds 8 permanent galleries, including bronzes, calligraphy, painting, seals, ceramics, currency, sculpture, and jade, showcasing the most comprehensive chronological display of ancient Chinese art.

In the bronze gallery, you can explore 3,600 years of Chinese ancient bronze art. In the archaeology gallery, you can see over 2,000 archaeological relics illustrating Shanghai's urban evolution over 6,000 years.

Admission is free. Opening Hours: 10:00-18:00 (last entry at 17:00), closed on Tuesdays (except national holidays). No reservation is required for individual visitors.

Audio guides available in Chinese and English, with prices of RMB 20 yuan per set for Chinese version, RMB 40 yuan per set for English version. Paid English guided tours starting at 300 yuan. Visitors can borrow wheelchairs and strollers for free with a valid ID or a deposit of RMB 300 yuan.

Best Time to Visit: Morning crowds are smaller; recommended to enter immediately after opening at 10:00 AM. Recommended visit time is 1-2 hours.

sources.title: 上海博物馆东馆_百度百科
sources.content:
上海博物馆东馆位于浦东新区世纪大道1952号，定位为中国古代艺术博物馆，占地4.6万平方米，总建筑面积11.32万平方米。

发展历程：2015年12月项目立项批准；2017年3月设计方案中标；2017年9月27日正式开工建设；2020年12月31日主体钢结构封顶；2024年2月2日青铜展厅试开放；2024年6月26日重新开放，新增10个展厅；2024年12月3日正式全面开放。

建筑设计理念源于「上海之窗口」概念。地上六层、地下两层，展示陈列区总面积约3.36万平方米，共设20个展厅。设计强调人为本、以文物为中心。

主要展览：中国古代青铜馆展出500余件精选展品；中国古代雕塑馆展出289件/套文物；中国历代书法馆和绘画馆展出王羲之等历代名家作品；陶瓷馆、货币馆、玉器馆、印章馆等专题展厅。

开放时间：每天10时至18时（17时后停止入场），每周二闭馆（国定节假日除外）。

sources.title: 上海博物馆门票价格：2026年最新票价及预约攻略
sources.content:
基本陈列免费，特展全价票80元，优惠票40元。部分特展需购票，如「了不起的老祖宗——周同学的时空奇遇记」主题艺术秀全价票88元，平日票68元，优惠票44元。

60周岁（含）以上老人、6周岁以上18周岁及以下未成年人、全日制大学本科及以下学历学生、现役军人等可购优惠票。

东馆散客免预约，持有效身份证件从B1层东门安检入馆。数字馆、探索宫等互动体验空间需专项预约。团体（20人以上）需提前7-14天电话预约。

开放时间：东馆10:00-18:00（周二闭馆）。最佳参观时间：工作日上午人流量较少。参观时长：东馆深度参观需4-6小时。交通：地铁2号线上海科技馆站8号口步行可达东馆。

65周岁（含）以上老人、残障人士、现役军人等可优先从绿色通道入馆。
